en.name: JBL Tune 510BT Wireless Headphones
en.shortDescription: On-ear wireless headphones with 40 hours of battery life.
en.description:
## JBL Tune 510BT

Lightweight on-ear Bluetooth headphones tuned with JBL Pure Bass sound and a 40-hour battery life.

- Bluetooth 5.0
- 40-hour battery, fast charging (5 min = 2 hours)
- Foldable, multi-point connection

so.name: JBL Tune 510BT Wireless Headphones
so.shortDescription: Dhegdhuumiyayaal wireless ah, leh baytari socota 40 saacadood.
so.description:
## JBL Tune 510BT

Dhegdhuumiyayaal Bluetooth ah oo fudud, leh cod JBL Pure Bass ah iyo baytari socota 40 saacadood.

- Bluetooth 5.0
- Baytari 40 saacadood ah, chaajin degdeg ah (5 daqiiqo = 2 saacadood)
- La laaban karo, xiriir dhowr qalab ah
